# A library with a header generated by Python, configure checks, and
# install rules for both CMake (find_package) and pkg-config.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(hello VERSION 1.2.3 LANGUAGES C)

find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
add_custom_command(
  OUTPUT generated.h
  COMMAND Python3::Interpreter ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generate.py generated.h
  DEPENDS generate.py
)

include(CheckSymbolExists)
check_symbol_exists(snprintf stdio.h HELLO_HAVE_SNPRINTF)
if(NOT HELLO_HAVE_SNPRINTF)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "try_compile() does not work")
endif()

add_library(hello hello.c generated.h)
target_include_directories(hello
  PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
  PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
)
set_target_properties(hello PROPERTIES PUBLIC_HEADER include/hello.h)

install(TARGETS hello EXPORT hello)
install(EXPORT hello NAMESPACE hello:: DESTINATION lib/cmake/hello FILE hello-config.cmake)
configure_file(hello.pc.in hello.pc @ONLY)
install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/hello.pc DESTINATION lib/pkgconfig)
